description: We are Team StarStuffs, participating in the Virudhunagar local event to tackle the 'Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions' challenge. We are looking for passionate, driven individuals with skills in coding, web development, AI/ML, data management, and data visualization to join our mission. Join us in building innovative health solutions for the future of space exploration!
summary:
OJAS is an innovative, gamified health monitoring platform designed to help astronauts maintain their physical and mental well-being during space missions. Long-duration spaceflight exposes astronauts to challenges such as microgravity-induced physical changes, sleep disturbances, stress, and changes in overall health.

OJAS transforms health monitoring into an engaging, interactive experience by combining health indicators, intelligent insights, visual analytics, and game-inspired interactions. It helps users understand health trends, monitor important indicators, and recognize potential changes through an intuitive dashboard.

By making complex health information easier to understand and engaging to explore, OJAS aims to support proactive health awareness, improve monitoring experiences, and contribute to safer, healthier, and more sustainable human space exploration.
details:
OJAS is a gamified space health monitoring platform that brings health data visualization, intelligent analysis, and interactive experiences together in one application.

How it works:

  • Health Monitoring: Presents important health indicators through an organized dashboard.
  • Data Visualization: Converts complex health information into understandable charts, trends, and visual insights.
  • Intelligent Insights: Helps identify changes in health indicators and communicate meaningful observations.
  • Gamified Experience: Uses a space-inspired interactive interface to make health monitoring more engaging.
  • Trend Analysis: Enables users to explore historical health patterns and understand changes over time.

Benefits and Intended Impact:

  • Encourages proactive health monitoring during long-duration space missions.
  • Makes complex health information easier to interpret.
  • Supports awareness of physical and physiological changes.
  • Improves accessibility and engagement through intuitive visualizations.
  • Contributes to the future of human health monitoring in space exploration.

Technology Stack:

  • Frontend: React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Python
  • Data Visualization: Interactive charts and graphical dashboards
  • AI/Intelligent Analysis: AI-assisted data interpretation
  • Development Tools: GitHub, Visual Studio Code, and AI development tools.

Creativity and Innovation:

The uniqueness of OJAS lies in combining astronaut health monitoring with gamification and a space-inspired user experience. Instead of presenting health information as conventional medical dashboards, OJAS transforms it into an interactive environment where users can explore indicators, understand trends, and engage with their health data.

The project considers usability, data clarity, accessibility, engagement, and the specific challenges associated with human health during space missions.
